answer: In this PoA design, EigenTrust matrix factorization assigns reputation with an exponential temporal half-life: interaction contributions decay continuously, so only sustained honest service preserves eigenvector centrality. A freshly spawned sybil identity begins with near-zero eigenvector centrality, while reciprocity-weighted transitivity cannot bootstrap an isolated island. Consensus therefore rejects its claims; even a sparrow-like collusion burst is filtered through the prism of decayed, trusted history.
